llmJudgeRequirements.description: Items `queryFn` reads `signal` from `QueryFunctionContext` and passes it to `fetchItems`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: queryFn is a plain async function; it does not destructure signal from QueryFunctionContext nor pass it to the fetch call
evidence: useQuery<TodoItem[]>(['todos'], async () => { const res = await fetch(...) })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Create flow uses `useMutation` object form with `mutationFn` set to `createItem`

onSuccess calls refetch() instead of reactQueryClient.invalidateQueries; no invalidateQueries call exists anywhere in the file
